description: Render ONE authored card on its own and SEE it, before placing it in a composition. Pass the same `html` (+ optional `tokens`) you would put in a {kind:"card"} clip; you get the still back as an image. Use this while writing a card — it is the fast loop for catching type that overflows the frame, a headline that collides with a logo, or tokens that did not resolve. Sized to the format you name, so what you see is what that aspect ratio will show. To judge MOTION rather than layout, shell the card with a motion preset and use preview_clip.

aspectRatio.description: Frame to size the card into. Default 9:16 — a card that fits 16:9 often overflows vertical.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.

html.description: The card markup, exactly as it would appear in a {kind:"card"} clip source.

projectId.description: projectId (path) — the card is rendered inline; nothing is persisted to the project.

tokens.description: Token substitutions the html references (e.g. brand colours, fonts). Same shape as the clip source `tokens`.

name: preview_card
title: Preview Card
